page.name: Lampstand

seo.title: Lampstand: Church Presentation & Live Stream Software
seo.description: Show songs, Bible verses and announcements on the church screen and stream the service to YouTube or Facebook with name bars and captions. For Windows, Mac and Linux.

page.tagline: Church presentation and live stream in one window
page.description: Songs, Bible verses and announcements on the church screen, and the same service streamed to YouTube or Facebook with name bars and captions. Windows, Mac and Linux.
page.longDescription: Lampstand is a desktop app for the person running the screens on Sunday. Paste lyrics and they become slides. Type a verse reference and it's on the wall, from the WEB or KJV Bible built into the app. The room and the live stream can show the same picture or different ones, with name bars, the sermon title, live captions and a ticker on the stream only. It records, streams to YouTube, Facebook, Twitch or Vimeo, and takes USB cameras, capture cards and shared screens.
productFeatures: Lyrics become slides at each verse and chorus
WEB and KJV Bibles built in, searchable, offline
Separate or matching pictures for the room and the stream
Name bars, titles, live captions and a ticker on the stream
Go live to YouTube, Facebook, Twitch or Vimeo, and record
Cameras, capture cards and screen sharing
Break screen with announcements and a countdown

download.requirements: For Windows 10 and 11, macOS 11 or newer, and 64-bit Linux.

installSteps.windows: Run the installer and Lampstand opens when it's done, ready to stream and record. If a blue "Windows protected your PC" box appears, choose More info, then Run anyway.
installSteps.mac: Drag Lampstand to Applications and open it. The first time, the Mac says it can't check the app: click Done, then in System Settings → Privacy & Security click Open Anyway. Works on Apple chips and Intel Macs, macOS 11 or newer.
installSteps.linux-deb: For Ubuntu, Debian, Mint and Pop!_OS. Open it with Software Install, or run: sudo apt install ./lampstand_*_amd64.deb. FFmpeg is installed with it.
installSteps.linux-rpm: For Fedora and openSUSE. Open it with Software, or run: sudo dnf install ./lampstand-*.rpm. FFmpeg is installed with it.

notes.title: Windows says "Smart App Control blocked an app"?
notes.body: Some new Windows 11 PCs have Smart App Control turned on. It only runs apps signed with a certificate Microsoft recognises, and Lampstand isn't signed yet, so on those PCs it won't open and there's no "Run anyway". A signed version is on the way. Until then, use another computer, or email support@eligapris.com and we'll let you know the day it's ready.
